children: The stock of Grasim Industries (₹3,034) is ruling at a crucial level. The long-term outlook will remain positive as long as it sustains above ₹2,628. However, the short term outlook turned negative for the stock.
Grasim Industries finds an immediate resistance at ₹3,128 and a major one at ₹3,290. A conclusive close above ₹3,310 will reconfirm the bullish outlook on the stock that will take it to new heights.
On the other hand, it finds an immediate support at ₹2,873 and the next one at ₹2,740. We expect the negative trend to continue for Grasim Industries.
F&O pointers: Grasim Industries November futures closed at ₹3,040.50 and December futures at ₹3,058.80 against the spot price of ₹3,034.
The November and December futures have added open positions despite the stock facing a correction from around ₹3,230 to the current level of ₹3,034. The premium indicates existence of long positions.
Option trading suggests the stock could move within the ₹3,000–3,300 range, where open interest has built up heavily at the corresponding put and call strikes.

Strategy: Consider calendar put spread on Grasim Industries. This can be initiated by selling 3000-put of the current series and simultaneously buying the same of the December series. This options closed with a premium of ₹38.10 and ₹71.90 respectively.

This will entail an initial outgo of ₹8,450 (market lot 250 shares), which would be the maximum loss if the stock moves contrary to our expectations. However, profit potentials are high if the stock rises marginally or stays at current level during the current series (expiry on November 23) and falls sharply in December.
We advise traders to hold the position with a stop loss of ₹2,500 and aim for a target of ₹10,500-12,000 (both based on combined value).
Traders can ignore the strategy if the stock opens above ₹3,075 or below ₹3,000 on Monday. Hold the position for at least two weeks.
Follow-up: We had advised traders to consider buying call on Wipro. However, stop loss would have triggered, as the stock declined contrary to our expectations.
Note: The recommendations are based on technical analysis and F&O positions. There is a risk of loss in trading.

title: F&O Strategy: Calendar put spread on Grasim Industries
